claim: The bug was in the live-feed merge logic in fetchLatest
The relevant code is now around TransferDesk.jsx lines 679-682
The merge logic deduped incoming updates by raw id
Talks category ids are prefixed with 't-' (e.g. t-gordon)
Done category ids are prefixed with 'd-'
When the backend reclassifies a transfer the new record arrives under a new id
The old category entry never gets overwritten when a transfer is reclassified
Both the old and new category entries linger in transfers state simultaneously
A reclassified transfer renders in both columns simultaneously
The merge key was changed from t.id to a new transferKey(t) helper
The transferKey helper uses player name and kind as its composite key
A reclassified transfer now replaces its old-category record instead of sitting beside it
